description: Get analytics (likes, reposts, replies, etc.) for a published post on X, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Threads, Mastodon, Instagram or Facebook. Note: Telegram does not expose analytics. The numbers come from a stored snapshot that is at most an hour old, so calling this often costs nothing; set refresh to ask the platform now instead.

post_id.description: Post ID to get analytics for

refresh.description: Ask the platform for the current numbers instead of reading the stored snapshot. Allowed once per post every 5 minutes; past that it answers 429 analytics_refresh_rate_limited with a Retry-After, and the stored numbers are still one ordinary call away.

name: chirpie_analytics
title: Get post analytics
